CREDITS:
anime: Re:Zero
song: Stay Alive
original artist: Rie Takahashi
instrumental:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mU_Ya8wpV5o 
artwork: https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/58088075
vocals, lyrics, mixing: esturd

LINKS: 
PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/esturd
BUY ME A COFFEE (even though I don't drink coffee):  https://ko-fi.com/esturd 

THANKS TO MY PATRONS:
Shina the ZT1 
Denise Eleshuk
IanF
Benjamin

HI GUYS:
here's a throwback :') I never did watch re:zero (shhh) but I recently looked up the translation to this song and realized how sad the lyrics were. Nothing like belting out a rock ballad to get out your inner angst :)

**if you want to use my lyrics, go ahead! no need to ask. all that I require is that you credit & link  back to my channel :) 

LYRICS: 
An unfinished puzzle
I wonder why that is
There’s something that’s still missing

We always pass each other by
It’s like we’re destined to keep drifting on 
Til we’re far away
But still, I walk on

I stay alive
I am all alone as I wander through the darkness
A pain remains in my heart
I didn’t know this would hurt so much
This feeling never fades

An unstable seesaw 
Oh, it’s too far away
I cannot see the other side

Oh, can someone send a sign? Guide my way
There’s nothing so I close my eyes
Once more, I pray

Oh, stay alive
Even now, I wonder, what could you be thinking about?
No tears escape from my eyes
But I still feel this loneliness
When I am on my own, ah
I’ve prayed for so long

Stay alive, stay alive, stay alive, ooh

An unfinished puzzle
I haven’t found the missing piece
A gentle wind eases silently by
It makes my heart weak

I stay alive
Where have you gone now? Oh, what are you doing now?
A pain remains in my heart
I didn’t know this would hurt so much
This feeling never fades

Stay alive, stay alive, stay alive
